description: This Java source file defines the class 'ConceptStateConversion' within the OpenMRS project. The class models the concept state conversion in a healthcare workflow, including properties such as concept, program workflow, and workflow state, with standard getters and setters, constructors, and a toString method. It includes annotations for persistence and auditing.
